answers.how: The butterfly moves about 240 pixels per second, giving a scale of 0.32/240 meters per pixel. Its maximum visible wing span is about 170 pixels.
The butterfly moves approximately 120 pixels from 0.5 s to 1.0 s. Using the motion-derived scale of 0.32/240 meters per pixel gives a displacement of 0.16 m.
